title: Chipsi Mayai: Tanzania's Favourite Street Food
excerpt: Chipsi mayai, chips cooked into an omelette, is one of Tanzania's favourite street foods. Simple and satisfying.
body:
## What is it?

Chipsi mayai means "chips and eggs". Fried potatoes are mixed with beaten eggs and cooked like an omelette.

## Served with

Tomato sauce, chilli sauce and kachumbari salad.

## Where

Street stalls and simple restaurants everywhere in Tanzania.

## Tip

Choose busy stalls where food is freshly cooked. See [drinking water and food hygiene](/blog/drinking-water-tanzania/).

## Try other street food

- Mishkaki (meat skewers)
- Mandazi (fried dough)
- Grilled maize
- [Zanzibar pizza](/blog/forodhani-night-market/)
